reason: The collaboration spawn API accepts inline message text but exposes no post-dispatch API that returns the actual dispatched prompt bytes or their hash. Therefore v3 inline delivery cannot satisfy the coordinator's actual-dispatch verification condition.

dispatch_contract.experimental_prompt_source: The isolated agent invokes file_read_prompt.ps1 with the exact input path, expected SHA-256, role, and run-specific attestation path. The script hash-guards v2, the complete v3 package, and the selected input before emitting the exact UTF-8 text to stdout without an added newline.
allowed_agent_reads: the one named critic or scorer input
hash-guard dependencies read mechanically by file_read_prompt.ps1
dispatch_contract.attestation: A run-specific JSON attestation records the exact path, SHA-256 and byte count verified before the model receives the prompt text. Missing/mismatched attestation invalidates the whole family.
dispatch_contract.output_capture: The isolated agent writes its role output exactly once to the assigned raw-output file. Root hashes that file before any scorer assembly; root never edits or normalizes it.

pre_spawn_checks: all nine category_v3 SHA256SUMS entries match
selected input SHA-256 matches its frozen/generated manifest
no prohibited prior output is supplied

validity.any_file_read_hash_or_attestation_failur: invalidate entire category family and stop
validity.no_inline_prompt_hash_claim: v4 makes no claim that an intended inline payload equals actual dispatch; experimental content is instead read from the hash-attested file.

authorization: No v4 critic or scorer run before coordinator closes this execution-instrumentation Extract gate.
